output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds a mintedAmount to the balance of the owner, without checking if the totalSupply + mintedAmount overflows. This can be exploited to increase the owner's balance arbitrarily.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It subtracts _value from the balance of _from, without checking if balanceOf[_from] < _value. This can be exploited to cause a denial of service (DoS) to the _from user.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It decreases the balance of _from, without checking if balanceOf[_from] < _value. This can be exploited to cause a denial of service (DoS) to the _from user.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds _value to the allowance, without checking if allowance[msg.sender][_spender] + _value overflows. This can be exploited to increase the allowance arbitrarily, causing a denial of service (DoS) to users relying on it.
